_about: Public-domain Charles Wheatly (1686-1742), liturgist, for the Word Hoard: A Rational Illustration of the Book of Common Prayer (1720), The Nicene and Athanasian Creeds (Moyer lectures, 1738) and Fifty Sermons on Several Subjects (London 1746, three volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 45 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wheatly-rational-illustration: A rational Illustration of the Book of Common Prayer (catalogued 1720)
